title: MouldMaster assessment inventory and answer-governance contract
scopeEquations: 157 = 30 technical + 27 regional + 40 scenarios + 36 diagnostic labs + 24 material labs
209 = 157 formal evidence-approved + 12 measured-evidence + 40 optional material-practice decisions

governance.answerSemantics: source-authored; runtime semantic answer mutation is forbidden
governance.optionalMaterialPractice: stable item id, explicit revision, explicit answerIndex and exactly one correct:true choice required
governance.choiceOrder: may be deterministically balanced by the source authoring layer without rewriting answer text
governance.formalApprovalBoundary: the 40 optional material-practice decisions are learner-visible but remain outside the formal 157 keyed approval bank
governance.measuredEvidenceBoundary: the 12 measured-evidence decisions are governed separately and are excluded from the 197 psychometric inventory
governance.competencyMetadataTarget: explicit authored item metadata is authoritative; text-regex inference is a legacy fallback/lint only until migration is complete

boundary: Inventory counts describe governed application decision surfaces. They do not imply external accreditation, regulatory approval, certification authority, or universal production-process validity.
